about: Ladies 327 titles the listing Breakfast with Santa and Mrs. Clause at Texas Roadhouse, Sanford, and gives Saturday, December 12, 2026 as the date.
The event page offers six seating times, each with a child ticket and an adult seating ticket, so a family picks one time for everyone in the party.
The organizer promotes the morning as breakfast plus Christmas activities and a Santa visit in one stop.
The ticket service fee is $0.38 on each $15 child ticket and $0.50 on each $20 adult seating ticket.
Each seating has its own ticket line on the event page, so a family of two adults and two children picks four tickets for the same time.
faq: How much does breakfast with Santa cost?
Child tickets for ages 2 to 12 are $15 and adult seating is $20, each plus a small service fee.
What seating times are offered?
When do ticket sales end?
Ticket sales end at 9 PM on Friday, December 11.
Who is hosting?
The Sanford group Ladies 327 hosts the morning.
Where is Texas Roadhouse?
100 Towne Center Blvd in Sanford.
How big is the service fee?
$0.38 on a child ticket and $0.50 on an adult seating ticket.
Do adults need a ticket?
Yes, adults buy an adult seating ticket for the same time as the children.

about: Ladies 327 lists this event under the title Cookies and Milk with Santa and Mrs. Claus, with Saturday, December 19, 2026 as the date.
Photo tickets come in bundles for one, two or three children, and each bundle is tied to an hour long time slot.
The organizer calls the afternoon a delightful holiday celebration for families who want to create magical memories.
The service fee is $0.38 on the one child photo ticket, $0.63 on the two child ticket and $0.75 on the three child ticket.
Each bundle ticket covers one, two or three children, which works out to $10 per child on the three child ticket.
faq: Is Cookies and Milk with Santa free?
Attending is free, while photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus are sold as tickets.
How much are the photo tickets?
$15 for one child, $25 for two children and $30 for three children, plus a small service fee.
What photo time slots are there?
11 AM to noon, noon to 1 PM, 1 PM to 2 PM and 2 PM to 3 PM.
When do photo tickets stop selling?
Photo ticket sales end at 11:50 PM on Friday, December 18.
Where is the brewery?
210 S. Magnolia Ave in Sanford.
What is the fee on a photo ticket?
$0.38 for one child, $0.63 for two children and $0.75 for three children.
Can siblings share a photo?
Yes, the two and three child tickets cover siblings together.
What does attending cost without photos?
Nothing, since the organizer lists entry as free.
Who hosts the afternoon?
Ladies 327, the same Sanford group behind the Texas Roadhouse breakfast.
